key_insight: DialogPII provides a multilingual synthetic dialog dataset designed to detect personal and sensitive information across realistic conversation settings.
clinical_relevance: It supports safer sharing and analysis of healthcare and other sensitive conversational data by improving automatic de-identification tools.
method: Generated and manually curated synthetic dialogs across 8 scenarios in 11 languages.
Converted dialogs to speech, transcribed them with Whisper, and aligned annotations between text and speech-derived transcripts.
Released baseline multilingual NER models for personal information detection.
evidence_signal: The dataset includes 19 entity types and was validated with inter-annotator agreement, translation quality checks, annotation projection assessment, and transformer-based benchmark experiments.
watch_item: Because the dialogs are synthetic and speech-derived annotations rely on projection and correction, performance may not fully transfer to real-world noisy clinical conversations.
paper_title: DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information
